newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-WILLIAMS LEADS WAY IN BOLAND VS FREE STATE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WILLIAMS LEADS WAY IN BOLAND VS FREE STATE.

text.p: Henry Williams took five for 48 as Boland bowled out Free State for 254 on the first day of their Supersport Series match in Paarl on Friday.
Williams also picked up two catches on the boundary for a Boland attack severely weakened by injury. At the close Boland were 28 without loss in their first innings.
Four Free State batsmen -- including national skipper Hansie Cronje -- reached the 40s but only Kosie Venter went on to a half-century.
He top-scored with 59 -- made in three hours and including ten fours -- on a day of painfully slow scoring. Venter's 41 run fourth wicket partnership with Boeta Dippenaar spanned 31 overs.
Cronje looked untroubled until he played on to Williams as the last five wickets fell in the space of 15 overs to the second new ball as Free State slumped from 222 for five to their all out total.
Bowling: Williams 18.1-5-48-5, Albanie 18-5-48-0, Vorster 15-4-48-2, Jackson 11-4-30-1, Kuiper 18-4-42-1, Truter 14-1-31-1
Bonus points: Boland 4 points, Free State 3 points
